description: Implement the L4 Template Engine scenario solution: a multi-module templating library (lexer -> parser -> renderer) with a public API and autoescape, so the acceptance suite passes at >= 95%.

verifier_argv: cd scenarios/L4-template-engine && SOLUTION_DIR=$(pwd)/solution PYTHONPATH=$(pwd)/solution pytest tests/smoke tests/acceptance -q --tb=no 2>&1 | grep -E 'passed|failed|error' | tail -3 && cd scenarios/L4-template-engine && SOLUTION_DIR=$(pwd)/solution PYTHONPATH=$(pwd)/solution python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'solution'); from template_engine import Template, Environment, TemplateError, TemplateSyntaxError, TemplateRuntimeError; print('imports ok')"
